options.name: Religious influence on legislature
options.desc: The legislative branch of the country's legislature is constrained by the Conclave, which can veto any legislature it deems not in compliance with the religious law.

options.name: Partial legislative secularisation
options.desc: The power of religious institutions in legislation has been constrained to an advisory role, while retaining some influence on resolving constitutional disputes and legal interpretation.

options.name: Independent legislative branch
options.desc: The legislative branch of the country's government is fully secular and free from outside obstruction.
